limits: One complete run of 30 samples per direction for each stage; no statistical equivalence or causal claim for every millisecond.
External desktop load differed. A parent compatibility verification may have overlapped the earlier part of stage1. Its completion receipt and load snapshots are preserved.
The incomplete disk-error run is excluded. A complete new step2-repeat run with identical source and seed is used.
Changed document revisions still require a whole canonical model build; remote full-model diff/verification and PM conversion remain.
DOM reuse uses stable block identity, style LWW references and per-block decorations. Structure changes, GC and undel paths that invalidate the block cache can still rebuild more DOM.
ASCII sequential insertion only; no IME, sustained typing, multi-user contention or large-table latency claim.
Same local machine and renderer thread; rendering-opportunity proxy, not physical display scanout.
